origin: Original AI-assisted analysis of existing local source and retained measurements. No imported implementation, new runtime capture, world, build or export. Runtime code unchanged in this review.
status: Stage and ownership audit complete; further runtime optimization deliberately not attempted without a focused experiment.
scope: Reuses the latest measured generation and final scoped loading captures. Warm OS/import/plan/derived caches, source/debug, offscreen Forward+, 1920x1080, 60 FPS cap, seed1703/generator29/default recipe and normal actors. Generation capture predates removal of redundant ordinary-load input prefetch; final loading capture uses its removal. No new performance result or universal regression claim.

ordered terrain earthworks and water bake

loading: bounded resource prefetch and owner-thread script compilation
owner-thread catalog/services setup with cooperative yields

residual_warning: Includes coordinator/bootstrap, verification, publication, handoff and playable loading. Not a separately timed 32-second load. Publication duration has no isolated timestamp in this receipt.
loading_scope_warning: The saved-world benchmark is read-only and temporary, so ordinary writable map warming is exercised separately after first-ready. Do not add its 1.325 s mechanically to a normal load, where it overlaps. first_ready is not first player control. UI stage wall times are overlapping observations, not per-stage CPU times.

coarse_landscape.interpretation: 64 unique size-256 root jobs dominate mesh work. Whole capture also includes post-ready small mesh jobs; those are excluded from this root group. Ordered terrain worker executes ordinary mesh jobs; native build methods take the mutable-core mutex. Extra callers on the same core will serialize.

generation.scope: Whole process capture including renderer, post-ready map verification and teardown. Not per-subsystem or click-to-ready CPU attribution.

loading.scope: Whole process capture including renderer, post-ready map verification and teardown. Not per-subsystem or click-to-ready CPU attribution.

save.interpretation: 136 asset jobs already use four participating model workers. Store opening is sequential (~2.1s); publication (~7.1s) includes IO/durability work. Raising threads is not an established benefit.

outdoors.interpretation: Per-lot surface batches and bounded density batches already exist. Remaining time is not split between survey waits, tree/road/conflict tests and ordered publication. Do not attribute all 15.9s to IO or missing threads.

handoff.interpretation: Verified bounded terrain packets and process resource caches transfer; full scene/native residency does not. Generation deliberately pauses general landscape streaming. 14 hits / 260 worker builds is not a potential savings percentage: much landscape work was intentionally never generated.

cache.interpretation: Warm caches are not fully populated mesh caches. Incomplete accounting keeps optional writes disabled and reports the limit conservatively; it does not prove physical fullness. Do not raise the cache budget to hide this.

decisions.candidate: Bounded parallel build of coarse landscape from a frozen terrain revision
decisions.next_step: Prototype two private readers/tasks with bounded result memory and unchanged 64-root plus local collision release gates. Measure decode/publication/CPU/memory and first-control timing as well as load wall time.
decisions.gate: Exact geometry/collision and saved-world identity; stale revision rejection, cancellation, shutdown and memory budgets; repeated matched normal-path comparisons.
decisions.risk: Requires explicit immutable/private-reader ownership. Ordinary core mutex prevents useful parallel callers; shared LRU/read caches cannot be used concurrently.

decisions.candidate: Attribute outdoor stage before changing scheduling
decisions.next_step: Add compact timing/count splits for surface and density waits, filtering and ordered insertions, then select one demonstrated waste.
decisions.gate: Same accepted and skipped candidate order, stable IDs/transforms, support/conflict checks and saved-world comparisons.
decisions.risk: Parallel insertion changes collisions/IDs and can change the generated world.

decisions.next_step: Only after above: inspect a frozen survey product and parallel model-store open with private ownership; keep root/map publication tied to the same durable checkpoint.
decisions.gate: Exact maps, failure recovery and cancelled/failed publication preserving old saves; repeated end-to-end gain.
decisions.risk: Map source access may contend with store publication; durability and leases must remain intact.

decisions.candidate: Keep the generated scene alive for play
decisions.next_step: Defer as architectural work; requires explicit transfer of destination lease, regional stores, services and recovery state.
decisions.gate: Ordinary generate, publication, cancellation/failure and fresh reopen plus player-control/visual checks.
decisions.risk: Skipping save/verify/reload or rendering the whole landscape during generation can merely shift work or undermine recoverability.

measurement_followup: Future capture should timestamp verification, publication, map readiness, loading barrier, intro completion and first player control separately. Reuse latest captures for this audit; no unchanged full generation was rerun.
